verdict: Lead volume is critically low; spend throttle and pipeline gaps must close now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 7 tracked leads at a cost of $238.33 per lead — a level that is not sustainable heading into heating season. The immediate cause is a sharp pullback in Google Ads spend, which dropped 67% in the last 7 days alone and is producing roughly $47 per day in total ad spend across all channels. At the same time, a large gap has opened in your pipeline: 834 opportunities have been created but only 47 won, and with no confirmed intake owner since early July, incoming leads are at risk of going unworked. We are prioritizing restoring Google Ads to full volume, confirming the intake owner seat, and delivering the outstanding milestones — financing page, Homer Glen branch, and LSA heating toggle — ahead of the October heating campaign launch.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days — a chronic drought, not a one-week blip
average cost per lead this period, up as spend efficiency fell alongside volume
total Google Business Profile calls came from one profile — Quality HVAC Solutions — while the other two produced almost none

watch_item.issue: 834 open pipeline opportunities with no confirmed intake owner, meaning leads arriving now may not be followed up on.
watch_item.fix: Confirming the intake owner role is the immediate unlock; that seat being filled is what allows every other scale-up step to proceed.
